clue.text: 8 9s acceptable in late playing by United

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: Pacific islands

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the other here, the short word set into the scrambled letters
playing suggests the letters of late are performing in a new order

parts.note: acceptable means OK
U is the usual abbreviation for United, as in football club names

explanation.surface: Pacific islanders who are acceptable despite turning up late to a match played by United.
explanation.walkthrough: 'late playing' reads like a tardy match, but 'playing' scrambles the word and 'in' sets the acceptable piece inside it; 'by' only joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Tokelau is a group of three atolls in the South Pacific, a New Zealand territory.

clue.text: Get supplies from a company I set up to deliver pudding

parts.note: to tap a source is to draw supplies from it

indicators.note: set up, in a down clue, means the pieces are read upwards

explanation.surface: A firm is founded to supply desserts.
explanation.definitionFit: Tapioca, starchy grains from cassava root, is cooked with milk as a classic milk dessert.

clue.text: Gives up dessert to make a good beginning

parts.note: to kick a habit is to give it up, so kicks means gives up
a tart is a pastry dessert

explanation.surface: Someone forgoes pudding to launch a fresh start to a diet.
explanation.definitionFit: A kick-start is a boost that gets something going vigorously, like a motorbike started by foot.

clue.text: Convicted murderer, say, has story about fellow murderer, ultimately

indicators.note: about means the story goes round the fellow letter

parts.note: a lie is a made-up story

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of the second murderer

explanation.surface: A convicted killer tells a tale about another killer.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifer is someone serving a life sentence, typical of a convicted murderer.

clue.text: Enjoying sex, hurry after a Parisian Catholic

indicators.note: after places the hurry piece behind the others

parts.note: un is French for a, as said in Paris
haste means hurry

explanation.surface: A sex-loving person rushes after a Catholic in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Enjoying sex' is a loose definition for not chaste, especially outside marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Unchaste describes someone not abstaining from sexual activity, the opposite of virtuous restraint.

clue.text: In France you mostly rate 8 9s

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: Pacific islands

parts.note: the French word for you (familiar) is tu

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: to rate something is to value it

explanation.surface: A French aside: you, in France, mostly rate the Pacific islands highly.
explanation.definitionFit: Tuvalu is a small island nation in the western Pacific, formerly the Ellice Islands.

clue.text: Convoluted? Succeeded in blocking idiot getting an answer in algebra

indicators.note: in blocking means the succeeded letter is wedged inside the idiot

parts.note: a twit is an idiot
x and y are the usual unknowns sought in algebra

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a muddled algebra problem.
explanation.definitionFit: Something twisty is full of turns, so winding or complicated.

clue.text: Explosives? Behold! — I removed contents of roof

indicators.note: removed means the letter I is taken out

parts.note: voila is French, adopted into English, for behold or there it is
tiles are what a roof is made of

explanation.surface: A demolition expert reveals the roof was stripped of explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: Volatiles are substances that evaporate or ignite readily, hence the question mark for explosives.

clue.text: Brand new underwear

parts.note: a brand is a product line

explanation.surface: An advert for a branded new range of underwear.
explanation.definitionFit: Linen is an old collective word for underclothes, as in changing one's linen.

clue.text: Calm and quiet account interrupted by one loud one

parts.note: P (piano) is the musical instruction to play quietly

indicators.note: interrupted by means the account letters are broken open by what follows

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
F (forte) is the musical instruction to play loudly
one again gives the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Someone stays calm and quiet while a bank statement is disrupted by a noisy individual.
explanation.walkthrough: IFI sits between the two Cs of ACC.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacific means peaceful or tranquil, the sense in which the ocean was named.

clue.text: Man, say, is new in embrace of woman, mostly

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in embrace of means the new letter is held inside the trimmed woman
mostly means the last letter of the word for woman goes

parts.note: a lady is a woman

explanation.surface: A man, it is said, is new to being held in a woman's embrace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Man' is not a male here: the Isle of Man is the example, signalled by 'say'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Man, in the Irish Sea, is an example of a body of land surrounded by water.

clue.text: Laundry is no longer opening for him

parts.note: something that is no longer simply was

indicators.note: opening for means just the first letter of him

explanation.surface: A laundry business is no longer open to a particular man.
explanation.definitionFit: Washing waiting to be done, as in the week's wash, is clothes for cleaning.

clue.text: Voter's ban amended, following rule

indicators.note: amended means the letters of the phrase are revised into a new order

explanation.surface: A ban on a voter has been revised to comply with the regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone observant keeps to the customs or rules of a religion or law, so is compliant.

clue.text: Silver in no way recalled in 8 9s

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: Pacific islands

indicators.note: recalled, read as called back, means the pieces are read in the opposite direction

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
no way means not

explanation.surface: Silver is in no way remembered among the Pacific islands.
explanation.definitionFit: Tonga is a Polynesian kingdom made up of over a hundred islands in the South Pacific.

clue.text: A song receives review in prompt response

indicators.note: receives means the song takes the review inside it

parts.note: a lay is a song or ballad
crit is an informal word for a critical review

explanation.surface: A new song gets reviewed with a speedy turnaround.
explanation.definitionFit: Alacrity is eager readiness, the quality of a quick and willing reaction.

clue.text: Fiercely charge soldier coming in to work

parts.note: to ram is to charge into

indicators.note: coming in to means the soldier enters the work word

parts.note: to ply a trade is to work at it
a soldier ant is a worker caste ant, so ant stands for soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier charges ferociously into action.
explanation.definitionFit: Rampant means unrestrained and aggressive, like a heraldic lion rearing, so violently or savagely.

clue.text: Clean line in the sand

indicators.note: in places the line letter within the stretch of sand

parts.note: the sand is a playful way of describing a beach

explanation.surface: Tidying up by drawing a line in the sand.
explanation.definitionFit: To bleach is to whiten or disinfect with chemicals, a way of making something clean.

clue.text: Antenatal changes on a huge scale

indicators.note: changes means the letters of the word take on a new order

explanation.surface: Pregnancy alters the body enormously.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlantean, from the giant Atlas, means gigantic or of immense strength.

clue.text: 8 9s not half kind about most of Britain after upset

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: Pacific islands

indicators.note: not half keeps just the front half of kind
after upset says the trimmed country is thrown into disorder
most of drops the last letter of the country

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Pacific islanders are only half kind about Britain after a fall-out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' leaves BRITAI, and 'after upset' rearranges it as RIBATI.
explanation.definitionFit: Kiribati is a Pacific republic spread over thirty-odd atolls straddling the equator.

clue.text: Heavyweight Muslim preacher, almost a significant figure in Islam

parts.note: a heavyweight person is fat

indicators.note: almost means the final letter of the preacher is cut

parts.note: an imam leads prayers in a mosque

explanation.surface: A heavyweight Muslim preacher is almost a major figure in the faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Fatima, daughter of the Prophet Muhammad, is revered across the Muslim world.

clue.text: France and Japan amongst 2 8 9s

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: Pacific islands

parts.note: F is the international vehicle code for France

indicators.note: amongst places Japan between the two numerals

parts.note: 2 in Roman numerals is II
J is the international vehicle code for Japan

explanation.surface: France and Japan count among a couple of Pacific islands.
explanation.walkthrough: '2' is the number, not the clue 2-down.
explanation.definitionFit: Fiji is a Melanesian archipelago of over three hundred islands in the South Pacific.

clue.text: Fried meat or fish? First of recipes is fish

indicators.note: First of means only the opening letter of recipes is used

parts.note: taken as written
soles are flatfish

explanation.surface: A cookery question: the first recipe is fish, fried meat or fish?
explanation.definitionFit: Rissoles are small cakes of minced meat or fish, coated and fried.

clue.text: Comments for one in G&S

parts.note: say means for example, for one
taken as written
G&S, Gilbert and Sullivan, supplies the letters G and S

explanation.surface: Remarks made, for instance, in a Gilbert and Sullivan operetta.
explanation.walkthrough: G&S is Gilbert and Sullivan, the Victorian comic opera duo.
explanation.definitionFit: Sayings are remarks or proverbs, things people state.

clue.text: US city tears up design for some staircase

indicators.note: up, in a down clue, means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
rips are tears

explanation.surface: A US city rips up the plans for some stairs.
explanation.definitionFit: A spiral is a winding pattern, the shape of a corkscrew staircase.

clue.text: Judge following article about a Mediterranean city

indicators.note: about means the two As go round the following letters

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
ff. is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

explanation.surface: A judge pursues an article about a city on the Mediterranean.
explanation.walkthrough: Jaffa is the old port of Tel Aviv.
explanation.definitionFit: Jaffa is an ancient port on Israel's Mediterranean coast, now joined to Tel Aviv.

clue.text: Hollywood area invested in evergreen talent

indicators.note: invested in means the Hollywood area is placed inside the tree

parts.note: a fir is an evergreen tree
LA, Los Angeles, is the area containing Hollywood

explanation.surface: Hollywood money backs a perennially gifted star.
explanation.definitionFit: Flair is a natural aptitude or knack.

clue.text: Animal given to French city receiving zero sentiment

indicators.note: receiving means the animal and city together take in the zero

parts.note: a pig is an animal
zero looks like the letter O
Nancy is a city in north-eastern France

explanation.definitionFit: Poignancy is the quality of stirring deep feeling, a strong emotional charge.

clue.text: Set up university course about one 8 9

definitions.note: cross-reference to 8 and 9 across: a Pacific island

indicators.note: about means the reversed pair goes round the one
Set up, in a down clue, means the pieces read upwards

parts.note: a run is a course, as in a ski run
a means one

explanation.surface: A university course is established on a Pacific island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Set up' turns URUN into NURU; A goes after the N.
explanation.definitionFit: Nauru is a tiny Micronesian island republic in the central Pacific.

clue.text: 8 9 joining areas and territories?

parts.note: 8 9 is a Pacific island; joining the words areas and territories into one run, the and saying they meet, shows the island across the join

explanation.surface: A Pacific island that connects regions and territories.
explanation.walkthrough: Write AREAS and TERRITORIES as one run, as 'joining' and 'and' ask: arEAS TERritories shows the island across the join, a hidden word the parse grammar cannot split around and.
explanation.definitionFit: Easter Island, or Rapa Nui, is a remote Chilean island in the south-east Pacific.

clue.text: Blue Quarter, note, will encompass return of posh zone

indicators.note: return of means the posh and zone letters are read backwards

parts.note: U means upper-class, posh

explanation.walkthrough: 'return of' turns UZ into ZU, which goes after the first A of AREAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Azurean is an old poetic adjective for the colour of a clear sky, sky-coloured.

clue.text: Everybody accepting odd bits of rugby in part of Scotland

indicators.note: accepting means the word for everybody takes the picked letters inside

indicators.note: odd bits of picks the first, third and fifth letters of rugby

explanation.walkthrough: The odd letters of RUGBY are R, G, Y.
explanation.definitionFit: Argyll is a historic county on Scotland's west coast.

clue.text: Lizards disturbed us again

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of the phrase are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Some lizards have bothered us yet again.
explanation.definitionFit: Iguanas are large tropical American lizards, often kept as pets.
